scope: Standard attention KV sizing example and current vLLM cache / metrics documentation.

claims.claim: For standard K/V attention cache, memory scales with two tensors, layer count, KV heads, head dimension, token count and element bytes.
claims.notes: The 128 KiB/token and 1 GiB/8192-token example assumes 32 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 and FP16. Runtime overhead and sharding are excluded.

claims.claim: The KV cache budget competes with weights, runtime workspace, graph and other allocations; the available capacity is platform and configuration dependent.
claims.locator: CacheConfig GPU Memory Utilization and kv_cache_memory_bytes
claims.notes: Current CUDA/ROCm extensible cache behavior differs from fallback sizing paths.

claims.claim: V1 exposes Prometheus metrics including kv_cache_usage_perc, prefix_cache_hits, prefix_cache_queries and request latency signals.
claims.notes: Metric names and semantics are release-sensitive; some prefix metrics count tokens rather than requests.

claims.claim: When KV Cache capacity is insufficient, requests may wait or be preempted and recomputed, affecting end-to-end latency.
claims.notes: Exact preemption policy and mode are version-specific.
